Percentile definition differs (line 27). The Python's drop_flow_faults takes the 99th percentile with np.nanpercentile at numpy's default linear interpolation; the do-file's egen pctile(), p(99) uses Stata's default definition, which is numpy's averaged_inverted_cdf. The two p99 values differ whenever the 99th percentile falls between two order statistics, so an hour whose absolute flow lies between the two 3 times p99 lines is dropped by one file and kept by the other; the comment that no hour moves is asserted, not shown. Everything else matches (sign, year, mean, count). Three rules met.
